1.1 packing characterization

These tests establish a baseline for the migration described in V2_DESIGN.md; that document remains authoritative. They do not prescribe the v2 row layout. The release baseline is flocker 1.1-0. The characterization branch additionally fixes one singleton-visit bug: subsetting the static formatter’s index data frame must use drop = FALSE. The singleton-visit test is a regression test for that fix, rather than a claim that the unmodified release passes every case.

  • test-packing-characterization.R checks alignment of observations and unique event/unit/group covariates through nontrivial two-level permutations, including a singleton group and singleton visits. It also covers aggregated single-season sufficient statistics, singleton event-map dimensions, named augmented species with site mappings, and internal versus trailing dynamic units.
  • test-utils.R already covers deterministic ragged reconstruction across the event-varying single-season, two-level, augmented, and dynamic paths.
  • test-exact-likelihoods.R supplies independent marginal-probability examples and brute-force dynamic histories. These R checks alone do not establish that generated Stan programs implement the same likelihood.
  • test-singleton-draws.R and test-trailing-multiseason.R cover fitted output dimensions, group names, coherent two-level samples, and trailing-unit masks.

Keep the ecological expected values when replacing the reconstruction adapter. Do not preserve the old variable-width index columns or representative-first packing merely to satisfy characterization tests.

Intentional differences to account for during migration:

  • 1.1 does not generally preserve input dimension names in reconstructed outputs; fitted outputs manufacture site/visit/timestep names. The new tests check existing group/species names but do not require loss of other names to persist.
  • The aggregated single_C reconstruction repeats unit values over a rectangular visit grid, including unsampled visits. Its test records current behavior, not v2 availability semantics.
  • Dynamic internal gaps retain unit predictors through dummy event rows; trailing units are omitted even with complete covariates. The tests assert reconstructed ecological values, not dummy-row values or their preprocessing effects.
  • newdata_checks is not v2’s explicit data role. Prediction-only unknown outcomes and trailing forecasts need new v2 tests rather than inherited 1.1 expectations.

No new MCMC fixtures are required by these additions. Existing fixture setup is still eager; restructuring it into lazy per-family getters is separate work.

Run the focused baseline with the compatible local fixture cache:

FLOCKER_TEST_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.flocker-test-cache" NOT_CRAN=true \
  Rscript --vanilla -e 'devtools::test(filter = "packing-characterization|make_flocker_data|exact-likelihoods|utils|singleton-draws|trailing-multiseason", reporter = "summary", stop_on_failure = TRUE)'

An absent or incompatible cache triggers fixture construction through the existing setup code, even for a filtered run.
